legend: A primary omental gastrointestinal stromal tumour with mixed spindle cell and epithelioid morphology (shown here). Immunohistochemistry for KIT is negative (shown in <<#13470>>Fig. #13470), whereas DOG1 (ANO1) is diffusely positive (shown in <<#13471>>Fig. #13471). KIT-negative gastrointestinal stromal tumours often harbour PDGFRA mutations.
